svg.title: Nanolog
svg.desc: The Nanolog mark on a dark tile, the source of logo-512.png for places that take no SVG (letters, article covers). logo.svg and logo-dark.svg are the same mark without the tile, for light and dark backgrounds. Regenerate the PNG: chrome --headless --disable-gpu --hide-scrollbars --default-background-color=00000000 --window-size=512,512 --screenshot=assets/logo-512.png assets/logo-icon.svg
